voice.note: speaker → script/cast.json (voice, speed, pitch). Per line: speed (× the speaker's), pre/post (ms of silence before/after the voice), say (what is spoken, if not `text`). captionY (px or "high") lifts the caption above low action.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI), Adi Parva, Astika sub-parva, adhyaya 28: as Garuda comes, heaven fills with terrible omens (winds, falling meteors, a rain of blood); the gods arm themselves and surround the soma. Garuda arrives; Vishvakarma, who guarded the soma, fights him and falls, torn by his wings, beak and claws. The dust raised by his wings blinds the gods; at Indra's order Vayu blows it away; the gods attack and Garuda, roaring, wounds them; they flee: the Sadhyas and Gandharvas to the east, the Vasus and Rudras to the south, the Adityas to the west, the Ashvins to the north. (The cliffhanger looks ahead to 1.29: the fire and the wheel around the amrita.)
structure: From episode 21 (independent review): COLD OPEN (≤ 8 words, ≤ 3 s; opening style C: a statement card over the answer image) → title (hook post) → STORY from ≈ 5 s with the UNVOICED recap band over its first shot (KIT.series.recapBand) → turn at 40–60 % → the cliffhanger image + line → a ≤ 1.2 s NEXT › band over the cliffhanger image that dissolves into frame 1 (KIT.series.overlayNextScene). No fire edge in the Garuda arc from here.

strings.recapLine: Garuda flew toward heaven, for the amrita.
strings.vkEpithet: builder of the gods, guard of the amrita

lines.speaker: sauti
lines.text: One bird against all the gods.
lines.say: One bird [p:60] against all the gods.
lines.note: COLD OPEN (style C, moving from frame 1): Garuda bursts LARGE through heaven's white gate, wings slamming open, the gods' spears raised against him in silhouette.

lines.text: Heaven filled with omens: wild winds, falling stars, and a rain of blood.
lines.say: Heaven filled with omens: [p:100] wild winds, [p:60] falling stars, [p:60] and a rain of blood.
lines.note: STORY 1 with the unvoiced recap band: NEW LIGHT, heaven's courtyard under a bruised green-violet storm: winds tear the banners, meteors streak, a red rain (drawn as streaks, never gore).

lines.text: The gods put on their armour, and stood round the amrita.
lines.say: The gods put on their armour, [p:80] and stood round the amrita.
lines.note: STORY 2: the gods in a ring, spears and bows, round the white pot of amrita on its pedestal, seen from above.

lines.text: Indra himself stood among them, the thunderbolt in his hand.
lines.say: Indra himself stood among them, [p:80] the thunderbolt in his hand.
lines.note: STORY 2b: Indra in the ring of gods, LARGE, the vajra raised, lightning playing on it.

lines.text: Its guardian, Vishvakarma, met him first, and fell.
lines.say: Its guardian, Vishvakarma, [p:80] met him first, [p:150] and fell.
lines.note: STORY 3: Vishvakarma, the builder, raises his hammer at the gate; Garuda's wing sweeps him down (beats[1]); plaque.

lines.text: The dust of his wings blinded the gods.
lines.say: The dust of his wings [p:60] blinded the gods.
lines.note: STORY 4: a wall of dust rolls over the courtyard; the gods' figures blur and shield their eyes.

lines.speaker: indra
lines.note: STORY 5 · THE TURN (≈ 45 %): after a 0.85 s rest, Indra through the dust, vajra raised, cries out (direct speech).

lines.text: The wind swept the sky clear, and the gods attacked.
lines.say: The wind swept the sky clear, [p:100] and the gods attacked.
lines.note: STORY 6: the dust is torn away in long streaks (beats[0]); the gods charge with spears from both sides.

lines.text: With wings, beak and talons, he tore through them.
lines.say: With wings, [p:60] beak and talons, [p:100] he tore through them.
lines.note: STORY 7: three quick cuts on the beats: a wing-blow, the beak, the talons; weapons fly from the gods' hands (no blood).

lines.speaker: sauti
lines.text: And the gods fled, in every direction.
lines.say: And the gods fled, [p:100] in every direction.
lines.note: FRAME (Sauti at the Naimisha fire, a fifteenth angle: from directly above the fire, Sauti's hands flung outward).

lines.text: The Sadhyas and Gandharvas east, the Vasus and Rudras south, the Adityas west, the Ashvins north.
lines.say: The Sadhyas and Gandharvas east, [p:60] the Vasus and Rudras south, [p:60] the Adityas west, [p:60] the Ashvins north.
lines.note: STORY 8: a compass of heaven seen from above: four groups of gods stream away to the four quarters, each quarter lit as it is named, its plaque.

lines.text: But the amrita was ringed with fire, and a wheel of blades.
lines.say: But the amrita was ringed with fire, [p:120] and a wheel of blades.
lines.note: NEXT 1 (cliffhanger, the catalog line): Garuda alone in the empty courtyard faces the amrita: a ring of roaring fire (beats[0]) and behind it a spinning wheel edged with blades (beats[1]).
